title: selliguea fraser-jenkinsii
intro: Selliguea fraser-jenkinsii, commonly known as Himalayan Polypodium, is a plant species that belongs to the Polypodiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions due to its multiple health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestive health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea fraser-jenkinsii include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic activities, which contribute to its potential in treating fever, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
